basis.description: WEIGHTED MID-FIELD ROWS ON THE 022 BASIS (held-out file heldout/HELDOUT_026.md sha256 2016d960c982aeffa2b1bef5aaece9b7394e97139d9688b5f6abec3274606d15, written 11:31Z before the 11:31Z launch): start = C1-N1-022's exact JSON (2414 generators: 016 + 240 legqs R0 = 25 in the higher blocks m = 16..23; no new functions), continued 60 Gauss-Newton steps on GPU 7 (about 40 s per step) with the 81 rows of 025: the 67 rows of 016 at weight 1e12 and the 14 HELD-IN mid-field rows (N4-160 probes n = 19..31 odd at K = (n-1)/2 + 128 and + 512) at weight 1e16; MID 16; per-step density L2 step norms logged (candD2/legqs25_m16to23_heldin1e16_gpu_m16.log). HELD-OUT set (never rows): the 25 registered probes n in {19,23,25,29,31} x K in {600,900,1200,1800,2400} and the N4-160 probes n = 19..31 at K0 in {0,8,32}. Optimizer report (MID 16): G0 0.2783 (022 0.2811), sup|F| 0.1386 (0.126), rF 6.837, P2 223.7, G1 3.62; objective 1.3892e7 -> 1.3892e7 (the start value includes the 1e16 rows). Reading (FLOAT trial observation; no causal claim): the 14 weighted rows are satisfied to 5e-9 to 2e-6 (022: 3e-5 to 1.9e-4), the registered probes next to them (K = 600) fall by factors 5 to 50, the registered probes at r 25 to 28 (K = 900 to 1200, modes 23 and 25) rise 1.5x to 3x, and the registered probes at r >= 35 (K >= 1800) stay within 15 percent of 022's (largest (19,1800) 8.32e-4 against 8.30e-4; 9 of 25 above the graded ceiling against 7): the same pattern as 025 on a different basis. The control C1-N1-027 (same start and steps without the rows) separates the row effect from the step effect.
